limitations: Dilutive potential shares (ESOP, convertibles) are not present in dataset schema v1, so the diluted count is the EPS-implied count and carries the DILUTION_PROXY cap.

Net debt subtracts cash and cash equivalents plus liquid investments only; restricted balances, margin money and regulatory balances are excluded from available cash by construction (R-4.1 / Schedule III). Dataset schema v1 carries no restricted-balance line item, so the component is published as NOT_COMPUTABLE rather than as a zero.
The corporate-action table carries no dividend declaration record in dataset schema v1, so R-15 corroboration is unavailable for this assessment.
Net debt could not be derived (NOT_REPORTED), so every enterprise-value method is withheld rather than run on a partial bridge.

Associates/JV carrying value is not recorded in the dataset schema (NOT_COMPUTABLE: NOT_REPORTED), so the enterprise-to-equity bridge substitutes zero for that term under policy associates-treatment/1.0.0. This is a policy substitution, not an issuer-reported nil: equity value is understated by any associates/JV carrying value the issuer reports.

R-4.3's policy-default penalty is applied: the valuation leans on 2 distinct assumption category(ies) (POLICY_DEFAULT_WACC 0.2, POLICY_DEFAULT_MULTIPLE 0.15) triggered by DCF_FCFF/discountRate, PE_RELATIVE/targetMultiple. The reductions are additive and capped once at 0.35, so the published confidence carries a 0.35 reduction (×0.65); multiple methods sharing one assumption category carry one penalty, and no minimum-confidence floor exists.

A review flag is not a carrying value: no figure has been established, no unavailable input has been converted into a nil, and the flag changes no valuation output.
